snippet.title: It Was Not A Suicide Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
🩸 Adele is dead. The truth is hidden in the files.

Step into Rainier Falls, 2005, in our psychological horror detective simulation.

🔎 Find contradictions
🕵️ Uncover the suspects' lies
⚖️ Decide who is guilty
☠️ Make the arrest

But be careful... you only get ONE chance to make an arrest.

Are you brilliant enough to expose the truth?
